source: The author's own Doodad Composite recipes, built and checked in the Editor; merged into composites.json by scripts/build-composites.mjs

composites.description: A crushing press over a conveyor belt, built and checked in the Editor by the author (2026-11-09): a ConveyorBeltBridge running along y, two SpaceDockArch gantries at scale 1 standing across it 2.75 either side of the head, a DOM_Crate double crate (variation 1) at 3x scale hung 3 above the belt as the press head, an AlarmLight centred on each of the four pillars (switch them to Stand Unpowered when the press is safe), and a DO NOT ENTER decal (Decal variation 27) past each end of the belt. For a crush-timing puzzle: the head's drop and the lights are the encounter's triggers, not the recipe's.
